name: Crazy Eights
summary: Shedding card game where players match rank or suit and eights are wild to be first to empty hand.
rules_text: Use 52 cards, or 104 for 6-7 players. Deal 5 cards each, 7 if 2 players. Place rest face down as stock and flip top card to start discard pile. On your turn you must play a card that matches the top discard by rank or suit, or play any 8 to change suit to your choice. You may also draw from stock: draw until you have a playable card, or draw one voluntarily even if playable. If stock empties, reshuffle discard except top card to form new stock; if still unable to play, pass. First player to discard all cards ends the round and scores from opponents: 50 per 8, 10 per face card, face value otherwise. If stock is exhausted, lowest hand scores differences. First player to reach 50 points times number of players wins the match.
rating_reason: Classic shedding game, hidden hands, turn-based, arithmetic win.
